scope: Selected national requirements only; local restrictions, filming permissions and customs are not fully covered.

registrationRequired.note: Operator ID: 250 g or more, or 100 g or more with a camera.

pilotCertRequired.note: Flyer ID is required from 100 g. Additional competence depends on the operation.

altitudeNote: Open-category baseline: 120 m above the surface; see the Drone Code for exceptions and local restrictions.
maxDistanceRule: Keep the drone in direct sight and the surrounding airspace visible.

insuranceRequired.note: Not verified in this summary. Check the national authority for your aircraft and operation.

importRestriction.note: Import and radio-equipment requirements have not been verified.

nationalApp.name: CAA Drone Code and airspace guidance

notes: Desk research from official sources, not firsthand flight verification. Check current notices and site permissions before a flight.
